title: Delayed
lyrics:
[00:19.63]I don't roll up
[00:21.16]I just roll the pretzel bag closed
[00:24.61]When you leave, I'll pack snacks in bags before you go
[00:29.37]Take a tangerine and waltz with me before you gotta leave
[00:38.34]We try to always seize the day
[00:43.94]But it always gets away, yeah, it always gets away
[00:48.39]I'll see you off on the 8:50 train
[00:53.96]Won't be a minute late unless that shit's delayed
[00:57.75]Won't you come my way? (My way)
[01:01.27]By the train (by train, by, by train, yeah)
[01:06.89]Please don't be late (don't be late)
[01:10.49]Today (you know that you can't be late)
[01:30.60]Ticktock, ticktock, ticktock, ticktock, ticktock, ticktock, tick-
[01:35.27]Won't you come my way?
[01:37.44]Is that alright?
[01:41.60]Alright
[01:43.81]Alright
